channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Trump Administration Moves to Close A.I. Chip Loophole Ahead of China Trip
item.description: The rules have been a topic of fierce debate in the administration and would cut back on a booming data center business serving Chinese companies.

item.title: NPR: U.S. tightens controls on remote access to AI technology amid Nvidia fallout
item.description: The new rule closes a loophole that existed that allowed Chinese companies to still access advanced AI chips remotely, despite U.S. restrictions on their physical sale to China.

item.title: BBC News: Russell Brand prison message 'appalling' and being investigated, No 10 says
item.description: Brand's wife read out comments from the comedian on their podcast in which the convicted rapist said he was "not guilty of the offences I have been jailed for".

item.title: The Guardian: Robert Pattinson’s gift for cool, sensual menace makes him an exquisite choice as James Bond | Peter Bradshaw
item.description: Pattinson is a character actor whose talent for inscrutable appraisal may mean a new era for 007. Will this more willowy, classy Bond leave sexism in the shadows? • New James Bond announced ... and the name’s Pattinson,…

item.title: Al Jazeera: Nationwide ground stop could cost US airlines hundreds of millions
item.description: Airline executives support modernising FAA systems as US Transportation Secretary Duffy seeks $50bn from Congress.

item.title: Ars Technica: Supreme Court keeps injunction against DEI grant defunding in place
item.description: Appeals court ruling rejected grant cancellations on First Amendment grounds.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: Jensen Huang Is Gone. Now What?
item.description: After a shocking downfall, Nvidia’s CEO is out of a job. WIRED’s Lauren Goode explains what that means for the world’s most critical chip company, the AI industry, and Jensen Huang himself.

item.title: WIRED Science: Just 400 US Data Centers Use More Electricity Than Michigan
item.description: New Harvard research shows that data-center power demand is outstripping states—and that doesn’t even include facilities with off-grid gas plants.

item.title: WIRED Business: Jensen Huang Is Gone. Now What?
item.description: After a shocking downfall, Nvidia’s CEO is out of a job. WIRED’s Lauren Goode explains what that means for the world’s most critical chip company, the AI industry, and Jensen Huang himself.

item.title: The New Yorker: The Buddhist A.I. Sect That Wants to Take Over Silicon Valley
item.description: MAPLE promises to teach us how to live in the age of A.I. Its secret mission is much stranger.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: Lindsay Clancy Will Face a Second Trial
item.description: The Massachusetts mother accused of murdering her three young children will go in front of a jury again this spring.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: A Turnkey 2-Bedroom in Jackson Heights With a Wood-Burning Fireplace at $775,000
item.description: And triple exposures in a one-bedroom on Perry Street.
